text:
Nora: heads-up from a partner call — they accidentally committed tokens because our samples show `export RW_TOKEN=...` in some places and `REDWOOD_API_KEY` in others. They use GitHub Actions with automatic env injection and got a leak alert.
Ben: yikes. which samples?
Nora: aw-examples/video-summarize uses RW_TOKEN in the README, samples/chatbot-go uses REDWOOD_API_KEY_FILE, and infra/terraform/provision.sh echoes RW_KEY in a snippet.
Kai: is REDWOOD_API_KEY_FILE the one we want to push? I like file-based for CI (secrets mounted as files) instead of inline env.
Ben: agreed. Proposal: canonicalize to REDWOOD_API_KEY (string) and REDWOOD_API_KEY_FILE (path) both supported by SDKs. Also canonical org/project as REDWOOD_ORG and REDWOOD_PROJECT (no "_ID" suffix, shorter).
Nora: +1 on file option. Also docs should explicitly warn: do NOT print keys in scripts; use `cat $REDWOOD_API_KEY_FILE | rw auth login --stdin` or similar.
Kai: SDK behavior note: when both REDWOOD_API_KEY and REDWOOD_API_KEY_FILE exist, which wins? We should pick priority: file > env (file is more explicit). Log a debug message when conflict.
Ben: yes; and add a runtime check that fails fast in CI mode (env RW_CI=true) if both are present. Many partners run into ambiguous configs.
Docs-bot: reminder: docs maintainers, there's an outstanding PR that touches quickstart envs: https://github.com/redwood-inference/docs/pull/291
Nora: also platform ops suggested adding a JSON credential envelope for service principals: a single file with keys {"token":"...","expiry":"...","project":"..."}. SDKs read REDWOOD_CREDENTIALS_FILE if present.
Kai: we need to normalize error semantics across SDKs: 401 -> AuthError non-retryable, 403 -> PermissionError non-retryable, 429 -> ThrottleError retryable with backoff. Right now retry libraries catch different classes.
Ben: for rotation flows, recommend short-lived tokens (default 15m for CLI ephemeral), refresh via REDWOOD_CREDENTIALS_ENDPOINT when present. CLI should output machine-readable JSON by default and a human-friendly export snippet with a clear warning about expiry.
Nora: a UX gap: Windows devs copy PowerShell snippet into Bash and it breaks. We should show both shells in quickstart: PowerShell, Bash, fish.
Kai: good catch. Also add a small snippet in SDK init that prints a single-line migration hint if legacy vars seen: e.g., "Found RW_TOKEN; consider renaming to REDWOOD_API_KEY. See https://rwd.co/migrate-keys". Make it opt-out with REDWOOD_SILENCE_ENV_WARN=true.
Ben: action items I can take: update samples to REDWOOD_API_KEY/FILE, add conflict detection in node/python SDKs, and replace inline prints in terraform examples.
Nora: I'll file the docs PR to include PowerShell/Bash examples and add the credential envelope spec.
Kai: I'll open the Go SDK issue to add credential file + error normalization.
ops-bot: scheduled org rotation notice: org "partner-alpha" key rotation 2026-07-15T03:00:00Z. Contact security to opt-out.
Nora: thanks all. tagging @devex and @security for visibility. Will report back when PRs land. :thumbsup:
